The '''1953–54 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the 18th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. There was an important innovation, as in its final phase, teams from the Greek region participated in a single group for the first time, bypassing the "Athens - Piraeus - Thessaloniki" triptych. The opportunity to claim the title of champion of a provincial team, was given for the first time in the period 1938-39, but where the championship was held in 2 groups. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 10th championship being unbeaten for the 5th time in their history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/i-lista-ton-protathliton-elladas.7922743.html|title=Η λίστα των πρωταθλητών Ελλάδας|website=sport24.gr}}</ref>

The 6 clubs that participated in the final stage were as follows:
*'''[[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athenian]] Championship''': The first 2 teams of the ranking.
*'''[[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus']] Championship''': The champion.
*'''[[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian]] Championship''': The champion.
*'''Regional Championship''': The 2 winners (North and South group).

The qualifying round matches took place from 10 October 1953 to 31 March 1954, while the final phase took place from 4 April to 21 July 1954. The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
